text:
mei: Heads-up: RFC follow-up idea 1 splitting console view composition into a fast "tiling" path for pre-composed static tiles and a live fanout path for interactive widgets. Goal: reduce 95th for large dashboards.

rahul: Strong +1. Need to decide where RBAC runs: do per-tile during tiling or at fanout ingress?

ashley: My preference: authorize at ingress and bake perm-version into tile cache key. That makes tiles safe to serve from cache.

mei: We'll add tile metadata: sensitivity and last_updated_nonce. For sensitive tiles, skip caching; for medium, short TTL.

rahul: Also add a tile-ownership field so we can expire only affected tenant tiles on role change.

ashley: Telemetry: emit tile_hit_rate, fanout_latency_p95, auth_calls_per_view. Alert if tile_hit_rate < 20% after rollout.

sre-bot: canary job created at 1762754500 comparing tiling vs fanout for 200 dashboards.

mei: Action items: rahul to draft tile key format + invalidation doc; ashley to add metrics and alert definitions. We'll sync next week.
